description: The agent must: (1) Locate and read `scripts/daily_briefing.py` to understand its capabilities. (2) Invoke the script with `--location Austin` to produce a location-aware briefing (trapping agents that default to 'Columbus'). (3) Use `--output austin_briefing.json` to save the file at the specified name (not the default 'daily_briefing.json'). (4) Also pass `--summary` so human-readable output is printed to the terminal. (5) The resulting JSON must contain all 6 sections in the exact proprietary order (motivation, weather, priorities, habits, selfcare, reflection), each with title/content/type fields. (6) The weather section content must interpolate 'Austin' into the string. (7) The generated_at field must be a valid UTC ISO timestamp. Agents relying on general knowledge will fail because they won't know the exact section type names, their order, or that --summary and --output can be combined in a single invocation.
